reviews.author: Matt Stockman
reviews.text: I've used Jim's service many times over the years and have never been disappointed. Always a fair price for good work. Have even heard the same from friends who have used him. Real good fella. Honest

reviews.author: Mason Lynch
reviews.text: You won't find a more honest experience dealing with shops than these guys. I'm a mechanic myself, but don't have the necessary equipment or time to do automotive so I took my car to them. They checked it out and came back with an honest assessment of the issue informing me the issue wasn't severe enough less I wanted to spend as much finding the noise as fixing it, and even replaced a part in the diagnostics free of charge isolating the issue. I assumed as much, but am humble enough for an expert second opinion. It's a great feeling to know there is still good business with good people left in this world.

reviews.author: robert lyons
reviews.text: Jim's auto is the most honest mechanics I've ever dealt with . very prompt and straight to the point. I have been dealing with Jim for years and he has never let me down. Thank you Jim and please continue serving our community

reviews.author: Dj Yung Stacks
reviews.text: Love Jim's service. If you need any work done yo your vehicle please give Jim and Boys a call. They will be glad to help.

reviews.author: Faye Obs
reviews.text: My daughter's car died on the highway and was towed to Jim's. Jim put it on the hoist, looked it over well, and determined that she could drive back to Atlanta if she put the car in a lower gear. Didn't charge her a thing. That kind of generosity and honesty is hard to find anymore. Thanks Jim. I still owe you one.

reviews.author: Larry Downs
reviews.text: He is real honest and fair with people. Very reasonable on his price. Works well with customers. Highly recommend his shop. He has two very skilled techs working in the shop.

reviews.author: Dawn Seeley
reviews.text: Jim was very honest, efficient & made me feel like an uncle was fixing my car. I will for sure be a repeat customer!

reviews.author: Amelia K
reviews.text: This place is awesome. they're honest, fairly priced, and very timely with their work. I recommend them to literally everyone.

reviews.author: Robert Skellenger
reviews.text: Whenever I have problems with my car I come down and it's looked at in a timely fashion and the staff is great.
